title: Every fox like Joy
kaylee: Every other fox in the game now has Joy's new face: big cupped ears, a white snout, puffy cheeks, brows, brown paws and a big bushy tail.
questions: The Arctic fox: Joy's look, or keep it plain since it's a wild animal?
